newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA-EESTI KINDLUSTUS IN BALTIC EXPANSION TALKS.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA-EESTI KINDLUSTUS IN BALTIC EXPANSION TALKS.

text.p: Eesti Kindlustus, the insurance arm of Hoiupank , said on Monday it was in talks to start operations in Latvia and Lithuania.
"The talks are on a broad scale...with different partners including local insurance companies," the company's chairman, Ivar Virkus, told Reuters.
Virkus said Eesti Kindlustus wants to enter other Baltic markets this year, but there is no decision yet whether it will open its own office or cooperate with others.
Eesti Kindlustus wants to list its shares on the main list of the Tallinn bourse by November.
Preparations for the bourse listing are going as planned, Virkus said, adding it has completed the audit of its half-year results.
